verdict.rationale: A direct probe returned HTTP 200 at https://docs.synctera.com/openapi.json with an "openapi" key, so a machine-readable OpenAPI spec is publicly downloadable. The docs also link to generated API reference pages (e.g. /v2/reference/createinternaltransfer), consistent with a spec-backed reference. Missing for 10: first-party documentation that advertises and explains the spec download, and evidence of the spec's completeness or versioning (e.g. v2 vs v0 coverage).
